writel(value | perfect_match, ioaddr + XGMAC_VLAN_TAG);

```c
u16 perfect_match, bool is_double
writel(value | perfect_match, ioaddr + XGMAC_VLAN_TAG);
```

This ensures that the value passed to `writel` is consistent in byte order, preventing potential filtering issues on big-endian systems.
